faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.lead: Find answers to the most common questions about OICT_TechStore.
faq.a1: Standard delivery within Addis Ababa takes 1–3 business days. Outside Addis Ababa may take 3–7 business days depending on your location.
faq.q2: What payment methods do you accept?
faq.a2: We accept Chapa, CBE Birr, Telebirr, M-Pesa, Awash Bank, and Cash on Delivery. Online payment options are subject to network availability.
faq.a3: Yes. Products can be returned within 14 days of delivery if they are unused, in original packaging, and accompanied by proof of purchase. See our Returns Policy for full details.
faq.q4: How do I track my order?
faq.a4: Log in to your account and visit My Orders. You will see the current status of each order. You will also receive updates by email.
faq.a5: Yes. All online payments are processed through PCI-compliant payment gateways. TechStore never stores your card information.
faq.q6: What if I receive a damaged product?
faq.a6: Contact us within 48 hours of receiving the product with photos of the damage. We will arrange a replacement or refund.
faq.q7: Do you offer warranty on products?
faq.a7: All products carry the manufacturer's standard warranty. The warranty period varies by product and brand.
faq.q8: How do I cancel an order?
faq.a8: Orders can be cancelled before they are shipped. Log in, go to My Orders, and use the Cancel button. Once shipped, cancellation is not possible.

returns.title: Returns & Refund Policy
returns.windowText: You may return eligible products within 14 days of the delivery date.
returns.eligibilityIntro: To be eligible for a return, the product must be:
returns.eligibility2: In the original packaging with all accessories
returns.eligibility3: Accompanied by the original receipt or order confirmation
returns.eligibilityExcluded: The following items are not eligible for return: software (once opened), digital downloads, perishable goods, and items marked as non-returnable.
returns.step1: Contact us with your order number and reason for return.
returns.step2: Our team will respond within 1–2 business days with return instructions.
returns.step3: Ship the item to our return address using a trackable shipping method.
returns.step4: Once received and inspected, we will process your refund within 5–7 business days.
returns.refundsText: Approved refunds are credited to the original payment method. Chapa payments are refunded to the original account. Cash on Delivery refunds are processed via bank transfer.
returns.damagedText: If you received a damaged or defective item, contact us within 48 hours of delivery with photos. We will arrange a replacement or full refund at no cost to you.

shipping.title: Shipping Information
shipping.areasText: OICT_TechStore currently delivers across Ethiopia. Delivery availability and timelines vary by location.
shipping.major: Major cities (Dire Dawa, Hawassa, Bahir Dar, Ambo, Jimma, Wollega)
shipping.feesFree: Orders over ETB 5,000 qualify for free standard delivery within Addis Ababa.
shipping.feesFlat: For orders below this threshold, a flat shipping fee of ETB 200 applies within Addis Ababa. Rates for other regions are calculated at checkout.
shipping.processingText: Orders are processed on business days (Monday–Friday, 9am–6pm EAT). Orders placed after 4pm or on weekends will be processed the next business day.
shipping.trackingText: Once your order is shipped, you can track it in your account under My Orders. You will also receive status updates.
shipping.failedText: If delivery fails due to an incorrect address or no one being available to receive the package, our delivery team will attempt redelivery. After two failed attempts, the order will be returned and a refund issued minus delivery costs.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.s1Text: When you create an account or place an order, we collect your name, email address, phone number, shipping address, and payment transaction references. We do not store full card numbers or CVV codes.
privacy.s2Item1: To process and fulfill your orders
privacy.s2Item2: To communicate order status and updates
privacy.s2Item4: To improve our products and services
privacy.s3Text: We do not sell or rent your personal information to third parties. We share data only with service providers necessary to fulfill your order (e.g., payment processors, delivery services), and only to the extent required.
privacy.s4Text: We use industry-standard security measures to protect your personal information. Passwords are stored using one-way hashing. Payment processing is handled by trusted third-party gateways.
privacy.s5Text: We use cookies and local storage to maintain your session and shopping cart. No advertising or tracking cookies are used.
privacy.s6Text: You may request deletion of your account and associated data by contacting us at obsatesfaye6370@gmail.com.
